rationale: Lycopolitan orthographic variant of ⲡⲁⲛⲁⲣⲉⲧⲟⲥ (already in accumulated vocabulary). Variant spelling with -ⲁⲣⲉⲓⲁⲥ for -ⲁⲣⲉⲧⲁⲥ. The εἰκὼν of light is here placed 'in the Panaretos.'
Lycopolitan ⲛϩⲣⲁ⸗ϥ 'before his face,' here doubled ϩ (orthographic variant). Standard preposition + 3sg.m. suffix.
Lycopolitan ϩⲱϩ = Sahidic ϩⲱⲱϥ 'also, himself' — emphasizing pronoun/adverb. Used here in serial enumeration.
